title: Juicy Double Fried Slovakian Duck Confit
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring crispy double fried duck legs in a rich and savory confit, perfect as a hangover cure. This recipe is vegetarian friendly in the sense that it does not contain any other meats besides duck.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the flour, salt, and pepper.
Dredge the duck legs in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Carefully place the duck legs in the hot oil and fry for 5 minutes on each side.
Remove the duck legs from the oil and let them cool for 10 minutes.
Increase the oil temperature to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Double fry the duck legs for an additional 2 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
In a separate pan, combine the minced garlic, thyme, and bay leaves and saute for 1 minute.
Add the double fried duck legs to the pan with the garlic and herb mixture.
Let the duck legs confit in the mixture for 10 minutes, until the meat is tender and falls off the bone.
